title: The Platonic brain bridge hypothesis: human brain networks as an architectural prior for omni models
abstract: arXiv:2609.10947v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose the Platonic brain bridge hypothesis: omni models, which process video, audio and text jointly like the brain, converge on brain-like representations, and the correspondence is bidirectional. From model to brain, brain-likeness of seven omni models is stable across participants, and our encoding models on their internal hidden states rank first on the Algonauts 2025 out-of-distribution leaderboard. From brain to model, three contributions follow. Brain-MoE gives seven cortical networks one brain-pretrained expert each and raises held-out accuracy in all 15 model-benchmark pairs by 6.42 percentage points on average. Brain-AVQA builds questions from video clips labelled by the most responsive brain network; the real network-to-expert map exceeds shuffled maps in-domain on all three models. translated_title: 柏拉图式大脑桥梁假说：人类大脑网络作为全能模型的架构先验
translated_abstract: 我们提出柏拉图式大脑桥梁假说：全能模型像大脑一样联合处理视频、音频和文本，会收敛到类脑的表征，且这种对应关系是双向的。从模型到大脑方向，七个全能模型的类脑性在不同被试间保持稳定，我们基于其内部隐藏状态构建的编码模型在 Algonauts 2025 分布外排行榜上排名第一。从大脑到模型方向，本文有三项贡献：Brain-MoE 为七个大脑皮层网络各分配一个大脑预训练的专家，在全部 15 个模型-基准测试组合中平均提升留出集准确率 6.42 个百分点；Brain-AVQA 利用响应最强烈的大脑网络标记的视频片段构建问题，真实的网络到专家映射在所有三个模型上均优于打乱后的映射；Brain-Scope 使用稀疏自编码器将这种对应关系定位到一个小子集，移除该子集会在所有三个模型中削弱大脑预测性能。
tldr: 该论文提出柏拉图式大脑桥梁假说，证明全能模型与大脑表征存在双向对应，并通过 Brain-MoE、Brain-AVQA 和 Brain-Scope 三项方法将大脑网络知识注入模型、平均提升准确率 6.42 个百分点并精确定位类脑表征所在的模型组件。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Platonic brain bridge hypothesis, demonstrating bidirectional correspondence between omni models and brain representations through Brain-MoE, Brain-AVQA, and Brain-Scope, which inject brain network knowledge into models to improve accuracy by 6.42 percentage points on average and localize brain-like representations to a small subset of model components.
